note: THE CANONICAL A04 RENDERING FIXTURE. Christian: "use the exact A04 concrete game from this closure run as the canonical rendering fixture. For this first test, do not reselect or re-realize it." So rendering reads THIS artifact and never a fresh run. Regenerated by `npm run freeze:a04` only when the chain itself is corrected — as on 1 October 2026, when the derived roster was found never to reach the concrete game — and never hand-edited. If a run would otherwise produce a different game, that is a separate finding and this file does not move. Since 7 October that finding is not left to be noticed: `fixture-currency.unit.ts` recomputes the game every run and fails on undeclared drift.

choices.because: The initial holder of possession is a governed free choice, not knowledge: the Soccer Sport Profile bounds the relationship over the participating opposing teams and deliberately names no team, and SD-39 carries the choice. Either of the two established teams is a legitimate value, and the choice is arbitrary BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by neglect — the two members are indiscernible, which is precisely why which one starts cannot be derived and has to be chosen. Naming one handle commits to nothing about it: no football meaning is read into the ordinal, nothing downstream recovers instantiation order from it, and swapping the two would leave the game identical. Recorded against a qualitative bound, so it is reported as unverified rather than as checked (SD-15). CORRECTED 6 October: this was recorded as `#0`, and the realizer mints member handles from 1, so it named no team at all. It passed because the bound is qualitative -- boundCheck is UNVERIFIABLE_QUALITATIVE_BOUND, so nothing compared the value to the instantiated members -- and nothing reads `possession.team` yet. `realize()` now refuses a chosen value that has a handle shape and names no member, so this cannot recur silently. SINCE 13 October the register's declared domain for this row (`fillableFrom: performers.teams[]`) is enforced as well: the value must be a member of that collection as the game holds it, so it IS now compared with the game's teams and is recorded as WITHIN_DECLARED_DOMAIN rather than as unverified. The authored term itself is still a term in words. The decision remains the coach's: the activity tells them to pick, and the recorded handle stands in for that.
